title: Karbala mein kya
body:
karbala mein kya batayein hum ne kya kya dekha
hum ne laakhon mein hai shabbir ko tanha dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
yu to pani ko hai bechain pyase kitne
hum ne pyason ko taraste huwe darya dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun na ashkon ki jagah khoon bahaye abid
jis ne maadar ka ho jalte huwe burqa dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ne jab seena e akbar se nikaala naiza
saat aate huwe akbar ka kaleja dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye us baali sakina ko kahan neend aaye
jis ne baba ka gala aankon se kat'ta dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki hasrat liye dunya se gaye sabz qaba
subhe ashoor wo lut'te huwe sehra dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...
